title: SB open facing a BB 3-bet
keyIdea: Your SB open is wide, but you'll be out of position for the whole hand. Continue with solid hands; fold the weakest part of your opens.

actions.call: JJ-55, AQs-A8s, KQs-K9s, QJs-Q9s, JTs, J9s, T9s, 98s, AQo-AJo, KQo

notes.A5s: A classic bluff raise: the ace blocks AA/AK, and it can still make a straight or the nut flush.
